title: tokens-assets: a worker job stalled past its budget or the peg guard run failed

annotations.summary: A tokens-assets worker job ran past its budget without finishing, or a peg guard run failed (label: job)
annotations.description: Either the jobs dispatcher logged cloudrun_assets_job_stalled (a /jobs/<name> request is still in flight 30s past the budgetMs its scheduler body declared, or 480s when it declares none; the line carries job, elapsed_ms, budget_ms, revision and instanceId) or refresh-peg-guard logged peg_guard_run_failed (reason stage_deadline when one stage outlived the 60s budget, reason exception otherwise; `stage` names the table or provider it was waiting on, see the runbook). A stall with no matching failure means the handler is wedged on a query the database never answered or on the in-process connection pool: check pg_stat_activity for application_name = cloudrun-assets-jobs sessions waiting on locks (pg_blocking_pids) or idle in transaction, and Cloud Run request logs for the instance. Repeated stage_deadline failures at the same stage point at that table; a lock_timeout error message in the failure line points at a blocker (admin hard-delete transactions touch peg_guard_latest).
